sanskrit_verse: वृद्धे जनपदे राज्ञो धर्मः कोशश् च वर्धते । हीयते हीयमाने च वृद्धिहेतुम् अतः श्रयेत् ॥
transliteration: vṛddhe janapade rājño dharmaḥ kośaś ca vardhate | hīyate hīyamāne ca vṛddhihetum ataḥ śrayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the populace prospers, the king's dharma and treasury expand; when the populace diminishes, both decline—therefore, growth must be anchored in the cause of prosperity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derivative of collective flourishing
Causation flows from societal integrity to sovereign capacity
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with public welfare
Restoration logic demands structural support for generative conditions
Consciousness alignment necessitates governance rooted in abundance
executable_legal_axioms: IF population well-being increases THEN state dharma and resources increase
IF population well-being decreases THEN state dharma and resources decrease
GIVEN a declining society, THE ruler MUST identify and restore causal foundations of growth
THE measure of lawful sovereignty IS proportional to the thriving of its people
NO policy shall contradict the upward trajectory of collective consciousness
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters affecting national or regional stability, the Supreme Court must evaluate whether policies uphold or erode the foundational causes of societal expansion. Legal rulings must reflect alignment with the causal axis of dharmic prosperity rather than reactive symptom management.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality between rulership and public welfare. It reflects anupūrvaśaḥ—the sequential unfolding of consequence from root condition. Responsibility lies not in blame but in restoring the causal field of abundance. There is no punitive element; correction occurs through realigning with the natural law of mutual uplift.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assessment Protocol: Evaluate systemic structures supporting or inhibiting societal growth
Reintegration Mandate: Align governmental functions with life-enhancing outcomes
Completion Process: Address root deficiencies causing diminishment
Capacity Restoration Framework: Reinforce infrastructure enabling sustained expansion
Consciousness Alignment Audit: Ensure all administrative actions resonate with dharmic abundance
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: sovereignty derives from and serves the flourishing of the populace. Dharma is restored through alignment with the causal flow of prosperity. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
